Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1193
Claimant:
Sara Davis
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
June 24, 2023
Claim opened for a left-turn collision at an intersection involving a claimant who reports a concussion. The claimant is
rerpesented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
August 6, 2023
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and the coverage was active at the time
of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
August 12, 2023
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene, and spoke with the responding
officer who confirmed the claimant's presence.
September 8, 2023
Scene photographs were received and show some details of the impact, but no independent witnesses have come
forward to describe how the collision happened.
September 18, 2023
Inspected the vehicle damage, which is consistent with the described impact pattern for a left-turn collision. Parts list
and repair estimate were requested from the repair facility.
October 11, 2023
Took a recorded statement from the claimant regarding the crash sequence. The account covered the turn, the point
of impact, and the immediate aftermath.
October 29, 2023
Follow-up call with the claimant's attorney. The account given through counsel matched the claimant's recorded
statement in every detail discussed so far.
November 3, 2023
Checked prior claims and vehicle history. No earlier damage to this vehicle is on record, and no prior injury claims
involving the same body area have been identified.
November 10, 2023
Medical records requested. Initial treatment reports desrcibe a concussion, and the care so far appears to be a usual
course for this kind of injury.
December 6, 2023
Reviewed the treatment timeline. Treatment has tapered off as the claimant has improved, though the file does not
yet establish whether the injury came from this crash.
December 10, 2023
Spoke with the treating provider's office to confirm the treatment dates and the current status. Records indicate the
claimant's symptoms have been easing over the recent period.
February 10, 2024
Reserve reviewed and file remains open pending receipt of the complete medical records and the repair estimate.
Causation of the claimed injury is still under evaluation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
